Chapter 1 of 11 — The Bike in the Window

The Bike in the Window

Melissa was walking past the bike shop when she saw it: a shiny bike with a bell and a basket, sparkling in the window.

The price tag said $60. She didn't have $60 — not even close.

Then a cheerful voice piped up: "Hi! I'm Azul! Want some help earning, saving, and learning your way to that bike?"

Chapter 1 of 11 — The Bike in the Window

Needs vs. Wants

"Before we earn anything," said Azul, "let's get clear on something. A bike is fun — but you don't need it to stay healthy. That makes it a want. A warm coat, though? That's a need. Drag each thing below into the right box!"

Need
Want
Chapter 2 of 11 — Earning Her First Coins

Earning Her First Coins

"Money doesn't just appear," Azul explained. "That's how your dad earns his — by doing something valuable at his job every day. Now let's earn your first coins! Tap each job to do it."

Tasks done: 0 / 5
Chapter 3 of 11 — The Tricky Trade

The Tricky Trade

Melissa had 10 pink hair clips and really wanted her friend's stuffed unicorn. Drag the hair clips over to her friend to offer a trade!

Chapter 4 of 11 — The Invention of Money

The Invention of Money

"Even grown-ups study this stuff! People needed something everyone agreed was valuable and easy to trade," said Azul. Drag through history to see how money changed!

Seashells
Long ago, people traded seashells because everyone agreed they were rare and pretty.
Chapter 5 of 11 — Tough Choices

Tough Choices

"Let's practice with $5 of birthday money," said Azul. A coloring book costs $5. A toy car also costs $5. Drag your $5 coin onto the ONE you want!

Chapter 6 of 11 — What You Give Up

What You Give Up

"Here's a fancy idea," said Azul. "The opportunity cost isn't the $5 you spent — it's whatever you GAVE UP to get it. Tap to find out what you gave up."

Chapter 7 of 11 — Setting Up the Lemonade Stand

Setting Up the Lemonade Stand

"Let's earn some SERIOUS money toward your bike," said Azul. Drag the price and watch how many customers show up!

Price: $0.50 a cup
A fair price — a steady stream of customers!
Chapter 8 of 11 — Three Jars

Three Jars

"Let's practice with $10 of birthday money," said Azul. "Drag the coins to drop them into Spend, Save, or Give!"

Chapter 9 of 11 — The Bank

The Bank

"A bank is like a safe, trusted house for your money — and it helps it grow a little too!" said Azul. "Let's deposit your Bike Fund and watch the weeks go by."

Tap to put your savings in the bank.
Chapter 10 of 11 — Prices Creep Up

Prices Creep Up

"Here's a tricky one," said Azul. "Over time, the same dollar can buy less. Drag through the years and watch what happens to prices."

Grandpa's Day
A lollipop cost just 10 cents!
Uh oh — even the bike's price has crept up a little, from $60 to $63!
Chapter 11 of 11 — The Big Lemonade Weekend

The Big Lemonade Weekend

"You know everything you need," said Azul. "Let's have your biggest lemonade weekend ever and finish your Bike Fund!"

You Did It!

Melissa rode off on her brand new bike — earned, saved, and grown, coin by coin. Along the way she learned about needs and wants, earning, trading, money, trade-offs, opportunity cost, supply and demand, saving, banking, and inflation.
